entities.name: Mirrans
entities.description: The metal-fused inhabitants of Mirrodin, at war with the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: A civilization at war with the Mirrans, with an internal structure led by five Praetors.

entities.name: Praetors
entities.description: The five main Phyrexian Praetors, each quoted in Mirrodin Besieged flavor text.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A big silver golem with a fragmented, Phyrexia-influenced mind, shown on a Phyrexian throne.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Phyrexia's former leader, who is no longer with us; the mask of Yawgmoth is emblematic of him.

entities.name: Mask of Yawgmoth
entities.description: A mask with ichor-streaked eyes and a hollow wailing jaw, emblematic of Yawgmoth.

relations.quote: who's winning this war between the Mirrans and the Phyrexians
